study.title: Learning lab
study.hulls: Show collision hulls and finger pads
study.geometry: Axes: X red / Y green / Z blue. Collision mode displays compiled convex hulls and pads through translucent visuals.
study.disabled: Enable the obstacle to measure the nearest surface distance.
study.legend: Red dashes: rejected direct path. Red marker: collision/clearance conflict. Green: validated TCP samples and safe waypoints.
study.idle: Select Red transport scene to observe sampling, collision checks and detour candidates.
study.experiment1: Experiment 1: narrow joint2 lower/upper limits and inspect line diagnostics. Keep ready_pose within the range. Sync a valid edit and move the joint; use frames and collision hulls to inspect the result.
study.experiment2: Experiment 2: start the red transport scene and compare rejected and accepted paths. Stop, adjust the box, and retry. Overlapping placements are rejected. The finite candidate search stops when no safe path is found.
